_help: Personal File Map settings for this folder, edited in the settings window that opens when you double-click the app. Created from the app's built-in defaults; any bill found that isn't listed yet is added as "monthly".

"folder": where the bill files are, relative to this file. "./" = this folder. Also accepts "./samples", "../2026", an absolute path, or "~/...". The PDF (personal-file-map.output.pdf) and the meter readings (personal-file-map.readings.json) are written there.
"bills": which months each bill is expected. Bills not listed (or null) are shown but never flagged.

A bill's name ends at a number: "#1", "#2" mark separate payments in a month ("Home Meter #1 Before", "Home Meter #2 After": the bill "Home Meter", 2 payments), a plain number is a document of one payment ("Property Tax 1 Assessment", "Property Tax 3 Receipt": the bill "Property Tax", 1 payment). A key also covers every bill that starts with it; the longest matching key wins.

"meters" (optional, added once you use the ⚡ button or pick a reader): electricity meter photos. "bills": bill names whose photos show a kWh meter, matched like "bills" keys, e.g. ["Home Meter"]. "reader": "off", "anthropic" or "openai". "models": model per provider, e.g. {"anthropic": "claude-haiku-5-5"}; a missing one uses the suggested model.

"meters" → "apiKeys": the API key per provider, in plain text. If this folder is synced (Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox) or shared, the key goes with it: remove it, or revoke it at the provider, before sharing.
